classification.difficultyReason: Read nested rectangles of 4×2 and 6×4 off the grid, compare the ratios 1.5 and 2, and explain why they are not similar. This is one non-similarity argument with a little extra reading effort.

content.prompt:
Here are two rectangles, P and Q, drawn on a square grid.

Is rectangle Q similar to rectangle P? Explain your answer.

answer.short: No. The side ratios are $1.5$ and $2$, so they are not equal.
answer.worked:
P is $4\times2$ grid cells and Q is $6\times4$ grid cells.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{6}{4}&=1.5\\\frac{4}{2}&=2\end{align*}$$
The corresponding side ratios differ, so Q is not similar to P, even though both have four right angles.
